definition: This dimension controls the maximum potential of skills based on usage, allowing for varying caps that can be absolute, relative to other skills, or dependent on other character attributes. It varies by determining whether skills can endlessly improve or are limited by specific thresholds.
exclusion_criteria: Skills can improve indefinitely without limits
Skill progression is entirely linear without caps or restrictions
inclusion_criteria: Skills have a defined maximum level that can be reached through practice
Skill caps can be influenced by character attributes or external factors
title: Skill Cap Variability
